# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

msgFlux supports the latest stable release on PyPI.

Pre-releases may receive fixes on a best-effort basis until the next stable
release is published.

Older releases are not considered supported.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please use GitHub's Private Vulnerability Reporting for this repository.

Do not open a public issue for a suspected vulnerability.

When reporting a vulnerability, include:

- the affected version or commit
- a short description of the issue and its impact
- clear reproduction steps or a proof of concept
- any suggested mitigation or workaround, if available

We will review reports as quickly as possible and follow up through the
private report thread.
